display.purpose: Hero numbers and the next-dose name — at most once per screen.

headline.purpose: Screen and section titles; top-bar title is Clinical Teal + 700 weight.

body.purpose: Reading text. bodySmall (12px) shifts to Muted Umber for de-emphasis.

label.purpose: Button, chip, and nav text — always semibold with light positive tracking.

chart-heading.purpose: The one hand-marked annotation heading per screen — Today's day-chart date. Italic Public Sans + underline stroke, never body text.

shadows.name: ambient-ink
shadows.purpose: The system's one shadow at rest. AmbientCard, dose rows, and (inverted) the bottom nav.

shadows.name: lifted-ink
shadows.purpose: Transient — plays only while a tappable AmbientCard is actively pressed, so touch reads as lifting the page.

shadows.name: top-bar-hairline
shadows.purpose: Neutral, near-invisible separation under the top bar only. Structural, not brand.

motion.name: fast
motion.purpose: Micro-interactions: press scale, card lift, nav pill swap, status glyph pop.

motion.name: medium
motion.purpose: Standard: page fade, calendar expand, card/row entrance.

motion.name: slow
motion.purpose: Values the eye tracks: progress rings, week bars.

motion.name: status-pop
motion.purpose: Status avatar overshoot pop whenever a dose's status changes.

motion.name: row-stagger
motion.purpose: Dose rows within a day settle onto the chart a beat after the one above.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single filled call-to-action per screen — Save, Confirm, Continue.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: 'Public Sans', Roboto, sans-serif; background: #00685F; color: #FFFFFF; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1px; padding: 16px 24px; min-height: 56px; border: none; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.05,0.7,0.1,1), background 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #008378; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6BD8CB; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Ambient Card
components.description: The system's signature container on the linen ground — lifts (deeper shadow) the instant it's pressed.
components.css: .ds-card-ambient { font-family: 'Public Sans', Roboto, sans-serif; background: #FBF7EC; border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(43,35,24,0.10); transition: box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.05,0.7,0.1,1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.05,0.7,0.1,1); } .ds-card-ambient:active { box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(43,35,24,0.15); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-card-title { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #2B2318; } .ds-card-sub { margin-top: 2px; font-size: 12px; color: #5C4F3B; }

components.name: Dose Row
components.description: The flagship chart entry — a permanent colored margin tab, a status ring with its persistent glyph, sitting over the faint ruled grid.
components.html:
Metformin 500mg
8:00 AM · 1 tablet
components.css: .ds-dose-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; font-family: 'Public Sans', Roboto, sans-serif; background: #FBF7EC; border-radius: 12px; border-left: 4px solid #00685F; padding: 16px; box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(43,35,24,0.10); } .ds-dose-avatar { width: 48px; height: 48px; min-width: 48px; border-radius: 50%; background: #00685F; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-dose-title { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #2B2318; } .ds-dose-sub { margin-top: 4px; font-size: 14px; color: #5C4F3B; }

components.name: Status Badge (glyph set)
components.description: The five-state, closed status set — every status is one color and one glyph, never color alone.
components.html: ✓ Taken – Due ○ Snoozed △ Missed
components.css: .ds-status { font-family: 'Public Sans', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.2px; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; color: #FFFFFF; margin-right: 6px; } .ds-status--taken { background: #00685F; } .ds-status--pending { background: #3D6FA8; } .ds-status--snoozed { background: #4648D4; } .ds-status--missed { background: #BA1A1A; }

components.name: Chart Date Heading
components.description: The one hand-marked annotation heading per screen — italic Public Sans plus a short uneven underline stroke.
components.css: .ds-chart-heading { font-family: 'Public Sans', Roboto, sans-serif; font-style: italic; font-weight: 600; font-size: 20px; letter-spacing: 0.4px; color: #2B2318; } .ds-chart-heading-rule { margin-top: 3px; height: 2px; width: 70%; background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0,104,95,0.45) 0 6px, transparent 6px 9px); }

components.name: Bottom Nav Item (selected)
components.description: One of four fixed destinations; selected state shown, on the Kraft Nav bar.

narrative.overview:
Medicyn reads as a chart clipped at someone's bedside — the object a competent visiting nurse leaves behind, not a monitor beeping in a hospital room. The ground shifted from the previous "Clinical Calm" system's clinical white to a warm linen/kraft paper; cards are pages that visibly sit above that ground, not the same material as it. Teal (#00685F) is carried over unchanged from Clinical Calm as the one brand/confirming accent — a deliberate continuity, not an oversight — but it now does its work against warmth instead of clinical neutrality.

The system's one genuinely new structural idea is that status is never color alone. Every dose status — Taken, Due, Snoozed, Missed, Not recorded — carries its own persistent glyph mark paired with its color. A faint, always-present ruled time-grid sits behind Today's list, and every dose row carries a permanent colored tab on its leading edge. A small steel clip motif sits at the top of Today and Care, holding the "page" in place.

Depth grew more present than Clinical Calm's flat baseline: the system's one recurring shadow reads with more presence at rest, and cards visibly lift the instant a finger touches them.
keyCharacteristics: Warm linen/kraft ground; cards are lighter "paper" sitting above it
Teal stays the one brand/confirming color, inherited from Clinical Calm
Every status = one color and one persistent glyph, never color alone
A faint ruled time-grid behind Today; a colored margin tab on every dose row
A steel clip motif marking the chart's "page" at Today and Care
One warm-ink shadow at rest, a deeper "lift" shadow on active press
Motion stays short (150–400ms) and fully honors reduced motion

rules.name: The Single Accent Rule
rules.body: Teal is the only color allowed to mean "brand" or "this succeeded." Taken is teal, never a stock green. Inherited unchanged from Clinical Calm.

rules.name: The Status-Has-a-Shape Rule
rules.body: Every dose status carries its own persistent glyph — check (Taken), dash (Due), ring (Snoozed), triangle (Missed), ellipsis (Not recorded) — paired with its color everywhere the status appears. Color alone is never the only signal.

rules.name: The Phone-Size Rule
rules.body: Sizes are tuned for a real handset at 100%; bigger text is the Settings Appearance slider's job, not a baseline bump. Inherited from Clinical Calm.

rules.name: The One Annotation Rule
rules.body: The italic hand-marked chart-heading treatment is reserved for exactly one heading per screen. It never spreads to body text, buttons, or more than one heading at a time.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: Ambient Ink is the only shadow a component gets at rest. Lifted Ink is not a second free shadow — it exists only as the transient response to an active press.

rules.name: The Two-Radius Rule
rules.body: Pill for anything tappable-as-an-action, 12–16px rounded rectangle for anything that contains content. Inherited from Clinical Calm.

dos: Do keep Clinical Teal as the only "brand/confirmed" color.
Do give every dose/task status both a color and a glyph from the fixed five-mark set.
Do reuse MedicynTheme.ambientShadow / liftedShadow exactly as defined.
Do route new date/section annotation headings through ChartHandLetteredText, one per screen.
Do cap page content at 640px via MedicynContent.
donts: Don't reuse Indigo Alert or Due Blue for anything other than Snoozed and Pending, and don't add a sixth status color.
Don't add a shadow anywhere beyond Ambient Ink at rest / Lifted Ink on press.
Don't apply the italic chart-heading treatment to more than one heading per screen, or to body text.
Don't override the system/app text-scale value with a fixed pixel size anywhere.
Don't port Cupertino-style components into shared code paths.
